LFS patients with lung cancer are not a rare event and the majority of them are diagnosed at a young age.

in the case of a patient with LFS and NSCLC, the first-line treatment would be an EGFR-inhibitor, and in the case of resistance, a third-generation EGFR-inhibiting agent would be the next option.

lung cancer in LFS is driven by oncogenic mechanisms, which are the same as in sporadic NSCLC.
